page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose cloud virtual instance built on KVM hypervisor technology and x86_64 architecture. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance includes 288.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU suitable for generic processing tasks.

The hardware configuration does not include integrated local SSD storage, requiring attached external cloud block storage for persistent data management. Network interface specs show a baseline throughput of 33 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default. The system lacks discrete GPU hardware acceleration.

This hardware balance makes the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge appropriate for general-purpose workloads, distributed microservices, application servers, container management clusters, and enterprise backend platforms needing high core density and baseline network throughput.
